about_the_game:
This is a placement game located at the bottom of the screen that will not affect your daily learning and work. Purchase resources and machinery, raise small animals, grow crops, automate collection，Craft Items Using Machinery  goods for coins and grow your farm. Manage your farm well to protect it from fierce beasts, and you are the best farmer!

Planting crops:

Grow diverse crops! Purchase seeds from the store and plant them in your newly cultivated fields. They'll also become essential sources for livestock feed and biofuel.

Building an electrical system:

Automated drones and robots require power supply. Construct generators and charging towers to energize them!

Let Robots Work For You:

Deploy cute drones/robots to assist in resource collection and combat. You can also change the operating mode of the drone through commands. More drones/robots Await Your Unlock!

Construction and production:

Buy machinery from the store, gather resources to make various items, sell them or make more advanced materials!

Breeding animals:

Purchase various baby animals from the store and raise them to adulthood! Your livestock serves as a vital economic resource. Beware of predator attacks - protect your animals carefully!

Farmers' Market:

Place your crafted goods or farm produce on the shelves for sale - this is a vital source of income!

Environmental Decorations:

Multiple background options available!

More buildings and gameplay features await your discovery!
